	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		current_year >= 1337
		current_year <= 1785
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_v58_sr_company_chartered }
		is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_v58_silk_road_spice_corridor
	}
	allow = {
		gold >= 150
		num_locations >= 8
		stability >= 0
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 18 }
		if = { limit = { gold >= 320 } add = { value = 12 } }
	}
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:burghers_estate background = estate_type:crown_estate } }

		name = oe_v58_sr_dec_charter_silk_company.a
